title: Between Use and Disappearance
description:
**Category:** Poster Design, Photography

A series of posters exploring the everyday act of discarding objects and the rapid cycle of consumption, from purchase to disposal.

Over the course of six months, I photographed abandoned furniture, household appliances, and building materials left outside my apartment building by neighbors. Disassembled beds, doors, toilets, and other discarded objects became the subjects of the series.

Stripped of their original functions, these objects exist in a transitional state between use and disappearance. I combined black-and-white photographs with clouds and fog, transforming ordinary household waste into surreal, almost ghostly landscapes.

The series was selected for the international poster biennial **Re: Rasa 2026**, which explored how personal experiences and local stories can be translated into a universal visual language.

One poster from the series, featuring a disassembled bed, was exhibited at **Paramadina University in Jakarta, Indonesia**, alongside works by **88 artists from 25 countries**.
